referenceSources.title: What's the Bugatti EB110 Le Mans car like to drive? | Top Gear
referenceSources.description:
A striking blue Bugatti EB110 LM, bearing the number 34 and Monte Carlo TMC branding, roars along a winding road. Gold BBS wheels spin beneath wide arches, while sponsor logos from Michelin, Esso, Ultron, and NRJ line the bodywork. The car’s aerodynamic vents and rear wing emphasize its Le Mans racing pedigree.

This photograph captures the EB110 LM’s dynamic presence outside the Circuit de la Sarthe setting. Its quad‑turbo 3.5‑litre V12 engine, producing 600 bhp, is paired with a six‑speed manual gearbox, delivering a visceral driving experience. Commissioned by Michel Hommell and driven from Bugatti’s Campogalliano factory to Le Mans, the car retains a well‑worn patina that speaks to its authentic racing history.
